guidelines.detail: refines EVT-03 (The records describe a delay notification, additional processing, and a later return of information. EVT-03 already requires a catch event when flow waits for a trigger; this guideline adds how to model the distinct steps along the delayed path.)

same as LRN-020 (The label-pair records show several generated labels that differ in meaning or specificity from the described actions and outcomes. The description supplies those distinctions, and LRN-020 already states essentially the same labeling guideline; FID-03 also supports faithful labels more generally.)

same as LRN-046 (The description says the process presents results through the interface, while the records show the corresponding participant and message flows absent and internal lanes added. This is essentially the learned guidance to model a communicating participant as a separate pool with message flows.)

same as LRN-046 (The description and collaboration records support a separate participant for the software interface and message flows for its interactions. This is already covered in substance by LRN-046, which calls for separate pools and message flows when an internal process exchanges information with an external participant.)

same as LRN-048 (The description supports alternative arrivals and a later response after the delay notice. The missing gateway and flows are consistent with that structure; the generated delay-notification catch event alone does not model the competing arrivals and subsequent wait. The guideline matches learned guideline LRN-048.)

documentation rule COL-01 not applied (The description supports interaction between the banking process and its user-facing interface, while the records show the interface pool and related message flows are absent. COL-01 already requires distinct interacting participants to be represented as pools; COL-03 covers message flows between participants. The learned guideline LRN-046 also states essentially the same modeling instruction.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an initial attempt may remain unresolved, identifies a notification and further processing before information is returned.: Model the notification, further processing, and return of information as distinct steps on the delayed path; in the receiving process, wait for the information with a message catch event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an initial attempt may remain unresolved, identifies a notification and further processing before information is returned.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes BPMN elements by their actions, objects, recipients, or outcomes

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an internal process sends information or an item to an external participant, or receives information or an item from one: Model the external participant as a separate pool and represent the stated communications with message flows.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies a software interface as a distinct participant that exchanges information with an internal process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that, after a request, either a response or a notification that further processing is needed may be received first: Model the competing message arrivals with an event-based gateway targeting message-catching events; if the notification leads to another response, model the subsequent wait with a separate message-catching event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that, after a request, either a response or a notification that further processing is needed may be received first

rules_sent_back.instruction: Create bpmn:collaboration when distinct participants interact and represent every participant as a bpmn:participant pool.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies a user-facing software interface as a point through which a person initiates a process or receives its results
